representation_fit.evidence: Canonical relational-web encoding: 35-node layered dependency graph in 4 hierarchy bands (source/app.js:12-17 BANDS; 1280x860.png shows 接入层/业务服务层/消息总线/数据与外部), 56 labeled edges with direction double-encoded blue=依赖 orange=影响 (styles.css:19-20, app.js:209-210) plus kind dash patterns (styles.css:199-200); relationship-as-content: edges are clickable with a dedicated relationship detail panel (app.js:420-442) and initial state already shows 7 edge labels (1280x860.png).

primary_task_salience.evidence: App boots directly into follow state on 订单服务 (app.js:769 follow(INITIAL_SEL || 'order-svc')), so the primary task (follow dependencies/influence) dominates first paint: blue/orange highlighted edges, sidebar lists 它依赖·6 and 被谁依赖·1 with per-row 跟随→ buttons, direction/depth controls in top bar (both screenshots; index.html:31-41).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy, not human: what/where is conveyed at a glance — title 依赖关系跟随 (index.html:20), global stats 35节点/56关系/4层带, hint pill 点击节点跟随依赖与影响·图谱始终保持全景 (index.html:79), 3-row legend (index.html:58-78), and the pre-selected node with labeled edges (both viewports render identically at 1280x860 and 1440x900).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero-mode single screen: a relationship is reachable in 1 step (click a labeled edge → app.js:615-616 → edgePanel), following in 1 step (node click or sidebar 跟随→ button, app.js:648-654), any node via search + Enter (app.js:732-736), closure via one click 看依赖闭包/看影响闭包 (app.js:660-661), backtrack via trail chips (app.js:666-673); no drill-down or mode switching anywhere in source.

context_loss.evidence: Directly addresses the seed: panorama never moves (static viewBox, no zoom/pan code), non-focused nodes dim to opacity .24 rather than hidden (styles.css:217), trail stays permanently lit during focus (app.js:307-312), numbered trail chips + 已走访 n/35 coverage (index.html:47-52, app.js:554-571), click-blank/Escape returns to overview (app.js:617-621,704-709), and state deep-links via URL hash (app.js:746-751); both screenshots show all 35 pills still positioned while following.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Purposeful but dense permanent chrome: top bar carries ~11 controls (brand, 3 stats, coverage bar, search, 3+4 segment buttons, 路径分析, 重置 — index.html:13-45), 3-row legend, hint pill, and up to 3 sidebar cards; every control maps to a needed function, but visit coverage is duplicated in top-bar mini-bar and trail-bar text (app.js:549-551 vs 568), and the top bar is at its packing limit at 1280x860.

accessibility.evidence: Visible affordances: interactive panel/trail/segment controls are real <button> elements with default focus outlines preserved (index.html:31-43, app.js:367-373), search has :focus style (styles.css:84), semantics double-encoded with shape+dash+text labels not color alone (styles.css:2-5); deficits: SVG nodes/edges are mouse-only — no tabindex or keyboard activation in buildNodes/click handlers (app.js:238-260, 612-622), search popup items are non-focusable divs (app.js:725-727), dimmed nodes at opacity .24 are low-contrast (screenshots), seg buttons 26px tall (styles.css:103-104); receipt side unevaluated: a11y.contrast/a11y.focus_order/a11y.target_size all 'skipped', target_invalid true (measurement-summary.json).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: no overflow, collision, or truncation in 1280x860.png or 1440x900.png (top bar, legend, sidebar all intact); zero receipt error failures recorded (summary pass 0 / fail 0, checks.layout.overflow etc. all 'skipped') — this is absence of observed defects, not verified correctness, since no check actually ran.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 关系跟随不丢失全局上下文 is explicitly engineered: trailbar comment 永不丢失全局上下文 (index.html:47), trail edges/nodes kept visible in focus mode (app.js:306-312), dim-not-hide focus (styles.css:217), click-blank overview restore (app.js:617-621), closure views at depth 99 (app.js:660-661), and hint text 图谱始终保持全景 (index.html:79); screenshots confirm the full 35-node panorama remains visible during the follow state.

defects_observed: All seven browser checks are 'skipped' with target_invalid:true (measurement-summary.json), so layout/a11y claims rest solely on manual screenshot and source inspection.
Non-focused nodes at opacity .24 (styles.css:217) render their labels nearly illegible at both viewports — intentional focus dimming, but a real legibility cost against the 'understand' job.

Graph nodes/edges cannot be activated by keyboard (no tabindex/keydown on SVG elements, app.js:238-260, 612-622); keyboard traversal is only possible indirectly via search first-hit Enter (app.js:733-735).
Search suggestion popup items are plain divs without ARIA roles or arrow-key navigation (app.js:723-729).
Visit-coverage is shown twice permanently (top-bar mini bar app.js:549-551 and trail-bar text app.js:568) — minor redundancy.
missing_evidence: Receipt-based a11y evidence absent: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size all 'skipped' (target_invalid true) — accessibility score is based on visible affordances and source only.
layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, type.min_projected_size never executed, so responsive robustness beyond the two supplied viewports is unverified.
No user study exists; time_to_understand is scored only as the rubric's model-judged proxy.
scores.overall_note: This package presents a layered dependency panorama (35 nodes / 56 edges / 4 bands) whose every core mechanism targets the brief's understand-relational-structure job and its acceptance seed: the app loads pre-following 订单服务 with blue/orange direction-coded, labeled edges (app.js:769; both screenshots), relationships are first-class click objects with their own detail panel (app.js:420-442), and following never leaves the panorama — trail chips, dim-not-hide focus, click-blank reset, and hash deep-links keep global context intact (app.js:306-321, 617-621; index.html:47-79). Navigation is one-click at every step and both supplied viewports render without visible collision, truncation, or overflow. The score is held off all-5s by two things visible in the material: the permanent chrome is dense with a duplicated coverage indicator (ui_surface_complexity 4), and accessibility is only partially demonstrable — real buttons and double-encoded semantics exist, but the SVG graph is mouse-only, dimmed nodes fall to opacity .24, and every receipt a11y/layout check was skipped with target_invalid:true, so those qualities are unverified rather than proven (measurement-summary.json). Per the rubric, task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are marked not_observable; no inference is made about which arm produced this package.
